references.text: The introduction to the curses that will come upon Israel if they do not obey the voice of the Lord, as verse 45 summarizes and confirms
The contrast to the blessings that come when one obeys the voice of the Lord, the opposite of the curses in verse 45
A parallel warning about curses resulting from disobedience to God's commands and statutes
Prophecy concerning distress that will come upon Israel due to disobedience
Fulfillment of the curse regarding plundering and destruction because of disobedience to the Lord
Repetition of the warning about destruction for those who do not obey the Lord's commands
Joshua's warning that curses will come upon Israel if they break the covenant
The prophet's lament that the people did not listen to the voice of the Lord and follow His ways
Further description of the destruction resulting from disobedience to the voice of the Lord your God
